title: Beyond Churn: Predicting Financial Fragmentation in Retail Banking with Temporal Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30364v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retail banking attrition is usually represented as a terminal binary event, even though client relationships often weaken earlier through partial movements of deposits, investments, and recurring activity to external financial institutions. This paper defines that preceding state as financial fragmentation and presents an end-to-end temporal machine-learning system for predicting it before complete disengagement. Using anonymized multi-source data from a large retail bank, the framework predicts whether a valid external transfer or investment event will occur within 90 days. The study uses 595,220 client-month observations, with 346 engineered features combining monthly client profiles, balances, product relationships, prior flow-of-funds behavior, macroeconomic conditions, and competitor activity. translated_title: 超越客户流失：基于时间机器学习的零售银行业金融碎片化预测
translated_abstract: 零售银行客户流失通常被表述为一种终末性的二元事件，然而客户关系往往在此之前就因存款、投资和经常性活动部分转移至外部金融机构而逐渐减弱。本文将这一先前状态定义为“金融碎片化”，并提出了一套端到端的时间机器学习系统，用于在客户完全脱离之前对其进行预测。该框架利用来自一家大型零售银行的匿名多源数据，预测有效的对外转账或投资事件是否会在90天内发生。研究使用了595,220个客户-月观测数据，包含346个工程特征，涵盖月度客户画像、余额、产品关系、历史资金流动行为、宏观经济状况以及竞争对手活动。一个四阶段的XGBoost级联模型用于估计：（1）90天内是否会发生对外资金流出，（2）预期金额，（3）流出来源……
tldr: 本文提出将客户流失前的“金融碎片化”作为预测目标，构建了基于四阶段XGBoost级联的时间机器学习系统，利用59.5万余个客户-月观测数据和346个特征，预测零售银行客户在90天内发生对外资金转移的可能性及金额，从而在客户完全流失前实现早期预警。
en_tdlr: This paper defines "financial fragmentation" as a precursor to retail banking churn and presents a four-stage XGBoost cascade temporal machine-learning system that uses 595,220 client-month observations and 346 engineered features to predict external fund outflows within 90 days, enabling early intervention before complete customer disengagement.
